messages:
alex: Quick preflight check — noticed AMS spot pool for p4d has ~8 nodes `NotReady` in the last hour, autoscaler didn't spin new ones. Can folks skim?

maria: looking. I saw a transient quota error on the API plane earlier. Did we hit cloud-side softlimits? :thinking_face:

jasper: I saw `InsufficientCapacity` on a few allocation events. Not sure if it's region flapping or our placement policy. Adding logs now.

team-provision-bot: [alert] 1759004390 - AMS-p4d spot pool: allocation_failures=5, recent_evictions=2

alex: thx bot. jasper — can you dump the last 50 scheduler events? If it looks like placement we can fallback to dedicated buffer in AMS for the canary.

jasper: dumping now, pasted the interesting tail:
```
I0312 10:12:03 scheduler.go:312] Allocation failed: InsufficientCapacity, zones=[ams1 ams3]
I0312 10:12:07 scheduler.go:315] Attempting fallback: spot->dedicated, candidate nodes=0
I0312 10:13:11 autoscaler.go:88] scaleUp aborted: quota_check_failed
```

maria: that `quota_check_failed` matches the cloud console: our spot pool request is hitting a per-project soft cap. I submitted a quota bump (ticket CLOUD-6421) but it's pending.

alex: okay—plan for today: 1) turn on temporary routing to dedicated-ams buffer for traffic tagged `canary` (low-risk) 2) keep spot pool attempts on but with lowered parallelism 3) ops-lead to follow up on CLOUD-6421.

sam: I can flip the routing. Quick question: what's the RB for dedicated buffer?

alex: dedicated-ams buffer is `dedicated-pool-ams-qa`, reserved ~12 GPUs; we've got 6 free right now. We'll use up to 4 for canary.

sam: doing the route toggle now. Will post command I run.

sam: ran: `redwood route update --from=canary --to=dedicated-pool-ams-qa --max-parallel=4` — got green. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. I also added a temporary autoscaler override to allow scaleUp even if soft quota check warns (will still not exceed absolute hard limit). PR is up: #482 — @alex can you review?

alex: on it, will review in 20m. Quick note for oncall: if we still see `NotReady` nodes after 15m we'll run the drain->recycle on the 8 stuck nodes.

ops-lead: keeping an eye. Also adding a follow-up to today's retro to discuss preflight signals — the quota bump latency is becoming a recurring friction point.

jasper: one more data point — CPU pressure on the stuck nodes is low, so it's not application oom. Likely allocation handshake failed. I'll open a focused issue with the scheduler traces.

alex: perfect. Blockers: cloud quota pending (maria), stuck spot allocs (jasper); Mitigations: routing to `dedicated-pool-ams-qa` (sam), autoscaler override (maria). Today I'm pairing with @maria on the CLOUD-6421 follow-up and will finish the review on PR #482.

maria: ping me if cloud support asks for additional info, I have the console session recorded.

sam: will monitor canary traffic for 30m and post metrics.

team-provision-bot: [info] 1759005660 - route change detected by sam: canary -> dedicated-pool-ams-qa

sam: 14m in and canary latency is stable. No errors so far.

alex: thanks team. If anything degrades, @ops-lead please escalate. Otherwise we'll keep this routing for the rest of the afternoon and reevaluate after CLOUD-6421. :thumbsup:
